100 Halloween captions you can copy in one tap

4 min read·Halloween

By Gül Eda Aydemir, indie iOS developer · Updated 3 Nov 2026

Your costume took days and your caption gets ten seconds. Here are 100 original Halloween captions, grouped by the kind of post. Tap Copy next to any line and paste it into Instagram.

All of them are written for this page and free to use, and most read fine in lowercase. There is a whole section for ghosts, because we did a ghost photoshoot and have opinions. Photos by @solo.stasera.

How to write a good Halloween caption

Say what the photo isn't saying. If the costume is scary, make the caption boring. If the costume is silly, make it deadly serious.

  • Play against the picture. A terrifying ghost captioned "laundry day got out of hand" beats "so spooky!"
  • Use one pun, not three. One is charming. Three is a greeting card.
  • Add a detail only you know. "the costume didn't last the night" makes people ask.
  • Post close to the day. Halloween posts are mostly looked at in the last week of October and the first days of November.
  • Tag whoever is under the sheet. Nobody can tell otherwise.

Frequently asked questions

What is a good Halloween caption for Instagram?

+

A short line that plays against the photo, such as "sheet happens" under a bedsheet ghost or "here for the free candy" under a dramatic costume.

What is a good caption for a ghost photo?

+

Deadpan lines work best: "i'm not antisocial, i'm dead", "laundry day got out of hand" or "ghosted, but make it fashion".

What is a short Halloween caption?

+

"stay spooky", "creep it real", "oh my gourd" or simply "boo." all work when the photo does the talking.

Can I use these captions for free?

+

Yes. They are original lines written for this page, free to copy and change.

When should I post Halloween photos?

+

Inspiration and how-to posts do best a week or two before Halloween, while costume photos and dumps suit the day itself and the days just after.
